required_semantics: the pedestrian later crosses the ego path
natural_language_contract.example_en: A pedestrian hidden behind a road barrier rushes from right to left into ego's path at 1.6 m/s.
natural_language_contract.example_zh: 一名被施工牌遮挡的行人以1.6米每秒的速度从右向左冲入自车路径。

category_policy.EGO: reserved for the controlled ego vehicle; never used as an occluder
category_policy.PEDESTRIAN: reserved for the rushing target actor; never reused as the occluder
category_policy.VEHICLE: car, van, truck and bus wording all canonicalize to this one visible category
category_policy.TRAFFIC_CONE: small static occluder; pilot determines whether its occlusion is physically useful
